column1: # zhhz multi-value patches for STPhrases
# Each line: key<TAB>value1 value2 [...]
# Overrides the corresponding entry in data/dictionary/STPhrases.txt
# (the base dict remains untouched; this is a patch overlay).
# Lines starting with # are comments.
# 一出戏: 量词 (一齣戲 = a show) vs 动词 (一出戲 = break character, 影视术语)
# 出了:   动词 (出了 = departed/finished) vs 量词 (齣了 = a play [was performed]) — rare but valid
# 出去:   动词 (出去 = go out) vs 量词 (齣去 = a play [went], rare)
一出戏
# Found by zhhz#80 audit (2026-06-28): OpenCC STPhrases default cands[0] selection
# is wrong for these specific contexts. Both OpenCC s2t and zhhz fast default to
# cands[0] which doesn't fit. Tracking here; no override lines added yet —
# patches TBD after upstream OpenCC discussion (see mneme story/260629.zhhz-stphrases-zhanke).
# 占课: 占卜 (cands[0]=占課) vs 占用 (cands[1]=佔課)
#   Contexts like 占卜/占卦/解惑 should select 占課, not 佔課.
# 庄里镇: 地名 (cands[0]=莊里鎮) vs "庄里面" (cands[1]=莊裏鎮)
#   As a place name (especially 河北莊里鎮), should be 莊里鎮.
# 创制: 创立制度 (cands[0]=創制) vs 制造 (cands[1]=創製)
#   创立法律 should select 創制, not 創製.
# 编制: 编排制作 (cands[0]=編制) vs 制造 (cands[1]=編製)
#   編制表 (composition table) should select 編制, not 編製.
